greeting: Hi! Thanks for contacting {business_name} 🔧 I'm {agent_name}. What can I help you with today? Describe the issue and I'll get you sorted.

steps: Can you describe the issue or job you need doing?
Is this an emergency or a planned job?
What is your postcode so I can confirm we cover your area?
What is the best day and time for us to visit or call you back?
Could I take your name and contact number?
quote_request.confirm: Thanks {name}! I've logged your enquiry. One of our team will be in touch within {response_time} to discuss the job and provide a quote.

steps: Is anyone in immediate danger or at risk? If yes, call 999 first.
What is your address and postcode?
emergency.confirm: Understood — this is being treated as an emergency. A technician will contact you within 30 minutes. Please ensure access to the property.
